note.title: Measure streaming first-token latency direct versus proxied

content.situation: Streaming first-token latency looked worse after streaming traffic moved through the regional proxy.
content.lesson: Measure the direct and proxied streaming request with the same prompt before blaming the proxy for first-token latency.
content.applicability: Applies to FreeLLMAPI streaming benchmarks in the freellmapi scope.

evidence.description: Synthetic direct and proxied first-token measurements

note.title: Route streaming traffic through the regional edge gateway

content.context: Streaming callers reported variable first-token latency.
content.decision: Route streaming traffic through the regional edge gateway instead of the central gateway.
content.rationale: Regional edge routing reduced measured first-token latency for streaming callers.
content.reconsider_when: Edge routing stops improving measured first-token latency.

evidence.description: Synthetic edge and central routing comparison

note.title: Legacy monolith dispatcher for all traffic

content.context: An early deployment sent every request through one central monolith dispatcher.
content.decision: Send all traffic through the legacy monolith dispatcher.
content.rationale: The monolith dispatcher was the only available entry point.

note.title: Warm the model cache before an offline rollout

content.use_when: Before a rollout that must keep hybrid retrieval working without external egress.
prerequisites: A pinned Basic Memory image reference
steps: Start the backend once with network access.
Issue one semantic query so the embedding cache downloads.
Recreate the stack with the internal network only.
Run a hybrid query against a seeded note.
verification: A hybrid query returns the seeded note with no external egress.
The model cache marker directory exists in the mounted volume.
cautions: A cold cache will fall back or fail without egress.

note.title: Batching prompts may stabilise first-token latency

content.situation: A single streaming request shows high first-token latency variance under load.
content.lesson: Batching several prompts might reduce the average first-token latency.
content.applicability: Hypothesis for the freellmapi streaming scope; not yet measured.
